mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term has p-value > 0.05 in regression models.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS), S&P 500 forward returns turn positive when GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2% annualized, reflecting accelerating corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth > 2%, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3% year-over-year) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal a monetary policy response to inflation that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term has p-value > 0.05 in regression models.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% over 3 months, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days as policy impacts corporate borrowing costs and economic growth.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% over 3 months, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
